question: Approve the re-scoped ideation: boot receipt plus fail-closed guard on the three authority verbs, at net +245?

artifacts.summary: Surface-only revision; spike and mechanism unchanged from the accepted cycle 1. Cut +540/12 files to +245/8 files three ways: the guard set narrowed from eight mutating verbs to the three carrying captain authority or terminal irreversibility (gate record, gate consume, merge guard) with the cap rationale recorded; the receipt shrank from a JSON format to one parsed line at .spacedock/boot/{session_id}; fixture files became inline string constants in a table-driven test. No AC lost its falsifier. AC-1 is a measuring AC — 0 of 3 guarded verbs succeed before re-boot against a baseline of 3 of 3 on today's binary. AC-3 pins the verdict to durable state only: deleting the receipt or appending the boundary record flips it with no conversational input. The test plan names the tautology-killer (refusal wiring fails if the preflight is never called) and justifies excluding a live smoke test — the sole runtime claim was already proven by ideation's live captures; every implementation claim is binary behavior. Breakout: product +95, tests +120, docs +30; tolerance 2x net.
